arxiv-2108-05780.title: Theory of Topological Superconductivity in Doped IV-VI Semiconductors
arxiv-2108-05780.creator: Zhe Li, Shengshan Qin, Jie Ren, Zhida Song, Dexi Shao, Chen Fang
arxiv-2108-05780.description: Abstract We theoretically study potential unconventional superconductivity in doped AB-type IV-VI semiconductors, based on a minimal effective model with interaction up to the next-nearest neighbors. According to the experimental implications, we focus on the spin-triplet channels and obtain the superconducting phase diagram with respect to the anisotropy of the Fermi surfaces and the interaction strength.

arxiv-2203-14805.title: Ulrich bundles on a general blow–up of the plane
arxiv-2203-14805.creator: Ciro Ciliberto, Flaminio Flamini, Andreas Leopold Knutsen
arxiv-2203-14805.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ciro Ciliberto, Flaminio Flamini, Andreas Leopold Knutsen. We prove that on X n X_{n} , the plane blown–up at n n general points, there are Ulrich line bundles with respect to a line bundle corresponding to curves of degree m m passing simply through the n n blown–up points, with m ⩽ 2 ​ n m\leqslant 2\sqrt{n} and such that the line bundle in question is very ample on X n X_{n} .

arxiv-2301-01888.title: An almost deterministic cooling by measurements
arxiv-2301-01888.creator: Jia-shun Yan, Jun Jing
arxiv-2301-01888.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jia-shun Yan, Jun Jing. Nondeterministic measurement-based techniques are efficient in reshaping the population distribution of a quantum system but suffer from a limited success probability of holding the system in the target state. To reduce the experimental cost, we exploit the state-engineering mechanisms of both conditional and unconditional measurements and propose a two-step protocol assisted by a qubit to cool a resonator down to the ground state with a near-unit probability.

arxiv-2309-16466.title: Entangling extreme ultraviolet photons through strong field pair generation
arxiv-2309-16466.creator: Jamison Sloan, Alexey Gorlach, Matan Even Tzur, Nicholas Rivera, Oren Cohen, Ido Kaminer, Marin Soljačić
arxiv-2309-16466.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jamison Sloan, Alexey Gorlach, Matan Even Tzur, Nicholas Rivera, Oren Cohen, Ido Kaminer, Marin Soljačić. Entangled photon pairs are a vital resource for quantum information, computation, and metrology. Although these states are routinely generated at optical frequencies, sources of quantum of light are notably lacking at extreme ultraviolet (XUV) and soft X-ray frequencies. Here, we show that strongly driven systems used for high harmonic generation (HHG) can become versatile sources of entangled photon pairs at these high frequencies.

arxiv-2312-06324.title: Thermodynamic Topology of D = 4 , 5 D=4,5 Horava Lifshitz Black Hole in Two Ensembles

A 2023 arXiv research paper by Bidyut Hazarika 1, Prabwal Phukon 1,2. I
Abstract

We study the thermodynamic topology of four and five dimensional Horava Lifshitz (HL) black holes in Horava gravity. These exotic black hole solutions belong to a special class of of black holes whose thermodynamics exhibit a line of (continuous) second order phase transitions known as
\lambda
phase transitions akin to those observed in the superfluidity of liquid
{}^{4}He
.

arxiv-2312-09682.title: Exploring the Feasibility of Generating Realistic 3D Models of Endangered Species Using DreamGaussian: An Analysis of Elevation Angle’s Impact on Model Generation
arxiv-2312-09682.creator: Selcuk Anil Karatopak, Deniz Sen
arxiv-2312-09682.description: Abstract Many species face the threat of extinction. It’s important to study these species and gather information about them as much as possible to preserve biodiversity. Due to the rarity of endangered species, there is a limited amount of data available, making it difficult to apply data requiring generative AI methods to this domain.

arxiv-2511-05283.title: Communication-Efficient Decentralized Optimization via Double-Communication Symmetric ADMM
arxiv-2511-05283.creator: Jinrui Huang, Runxiong Wu, Dong Liu, Jingguo Lan, Xueqin Wang
arxiv-2511-05283.description: Abstract This paper focuses on decentralized composite optimization over networks without a central coordinator. We propose a novel decentralized Symmetric ADMM algorithm that incorporates multiple communication rounds within each iteration, derived from a new constraint formulation that enables information exchange beyond immediate neighbors. While increasing per-iteration communication, our approach significantly reduces the total number of iterations and overall communication cost.

pmc-11314361.creator: Yaxu Wang, Xiaolong Ma, Hongmei Wang, Dandan Zhao, Yuheng Liu, Zichuan Ma, Xinhua Qi
pmc-11314361.description: It is important to develop effective strategies for enhancing the removal capacity of aromatic volatile organic compounds (VOCs) by modifying conventional porous adsorbents. In this study, a novel HZSM-5 zeolite-supported sulfonic acid (ZSM−OSO3H) was prepared through ClSO3H modification in dichloromethane and employed for the elimination of gaseous o-xylene.

pmc-11494016.title: Anticipatory and evoked visual cortical dynamics of voluntary temporal attention
pmc-11494016.creator: Rachel N. Denison, Karen J. Tian, David J. Heeger, Marisa Carrasco
pmc-11494016.description: We can often anticipate the precise moment when a stimulus will be relevant for our behavioral goals. Voluntary temporal attention, the prioritization of sensory information at task-relevant time points, enhances visual perception. However, the neural mechanisms of voluntary temporal attention have not been isolated from those of temporal expectation, which reflects timing predictability rather than relevance.

pmc-12411579.title: Pathophysiology of Femoral Fractures in Hypophosphatasia
pmc-12411579.creator: Fabiana G.A. Tabegna, Mark Garton, Simona D’Amore, Linda Skingle, Scott Dillon, Melinda J. Duer, Gavin P.R. Clunie, Kenneth E. S. Poole
pmc-12411579.description: Purpose of ReviewIn this review, we will examine the pathophysiology, anatomy, biochemistry, and genotype-phenotype correlation of femoral fractures in adult hypophosphatasia.Recent FindingsHypophosphatasia (HPP) is a rare genetic disease characterized by low activity of tissue-nonspecific alkaline phosphatase (TNAP). The disease presents a broad spectrum of clinical manifestations primarily determined by the degree of residual TNAP activity.

pmc-12612046.title: Long-duration human spaceflight induces atrophy in the left ventricular papillary muscles
pmc-12612046.creator: C. Tordeur, E. Abdessater, A. Hossein, F. Righetti, V. Sinitsyn, E. Mershina, E. Luchitskaya, E. G. Caiani, V. Faoro, J. Tank, P. van de Borne, P.-F. Migeotte, J. Rabineau
pmc-12612046.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Microgravity exposure induces cardiac deconditioning, primarily due to hypovolemia and inactivity. Animal models suggest microgravity may cause left ventricular (LV) papillary muscle atrophy, but this has not been studied in humans. This study used MRI to assess LV papillary muscle mass and LV morphology and function in nine male cosmonauts before and 6 ± 2 days after long-duration spaceflight (247 ± 90 days).

pmc-12956047.title: Scientific communication and vaccine hesitation: an analysis of the editorial line of a great Brazilian newspaper
pmc-12956047.creator: Heslley Machado Silva
pmc-12956047.description: The text critically examines the anti-vaccine editorial line adopted by “Gazeta do Povo”, one of Brazil’s leading newspapers, and its possible repercussions on vaccine hesitancy in the country. By analyzing headlines published over the course of a year, a trend of misinformation and sensationalism was found, addressing supposed or insignificant risks in relation to COVID-19 vaccines.

pmc-13097604.title: GlycA as an Effect Modifier of Protein–Mortality Associations: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-13097604.creator: Xinru Wang, Ziyan Qiao, Chengzhe Tao, Sijing Liao, Zhi Li, Qiaoqiao Xu, Yun Fan, Yufeng Wang, Yan Han, Xiuliang Dai, Chuncheng Lu
pmc-13097604.description: The heterogeneity in health effects of circulating proteins remained unclear. Previous studies have identified that glycoprotein acetyls (GlycA), a stable biomarker of inflammation, were associated with risks of mortality and chronic diseases. However, it remained unclear whether the health risks of proteins may differ across people with varied GlycA levels.

pmc-13104045.title: Mavacamten Reduces LVOT Obstruction Risk, Enabling Transseptal Mitral Valve-in-Valve for Degenerated Bioprosthesis
pmc-13104045.creator: Alexander Hoss, Fabian Voß, Amin Polzin
pmc-13104045.description: BackgroundTranscatheter mitral valve replacement (TMVR) is an alternative to redo surgery for failed mitral bioprostheses, but left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) obstruction remains a major limitation.Case SummaryAn 86-year-old woman presented with heart failure due to severe prosthetic mitral restenosis. Screening computed tomography (CT) predicted a critically small neo-LVOT, rendering TMVR prohibitive.

pmc-13390446.title: Anesthesia management for laparoscopic cholecystectomy and choledochoscopy-assisted intrahepatic bile duct stone extraction in a patient with situs inversus totalis, decompensated cirrhosis, and respiratory insufficiency: a case report
pmc-13390446.creator: Li Chen, Guoao Shi, Yihua Huang, Hengwei Sheng, Xu Dong, Li Kang
pmc-13390446.description: BackgroundSitus inversus totalis (SIT) is a rare congenital anatomical anomaly characterized by mirror-image reversal of thoracic and abdominal organs. Perioperative management becomes particularly challenging when SIT coexists with inferior vena cava (IVC) malformation (e.g., agenesis of the hepatic segment), decompensated cirrhosis, and respiratory insufficiency—a complex scenario for which relevant anesthesia experience is exceedingly limited.

pmc-13565909.title: Comparative Analysis of Phenolic Acid Profiles, Antioxidant Capacity, and Antimicrobial Activity of Honeys from Different Botanical and Geographical Origins
pmc-13565909.creator: Corina-Bianca Ioniță-Mîndrican, Antoanela Popescu, Magdalena Mititelu, Denisa-Elena Dumitrescu, Carolina Negrei, Iuliana Stoicescu, Violeta Popovici, Carmen Elena Lupu, Alina Maria Holban, Irinel Adriana Badea, Leontina Elena Filipiuc, Eliza Oprea
pmc-13565909.description: The composition of honey is complex and can vary depending on its botanical and geographical origin. This study evaluated the phenolic acid profile (PAP), antioxidant activity, and antimicrobial properties of honey samples from different geographical origins, such as Romania (nine types: multiflower, thyme, manna, hawthorn, black locust, linden, rapeseed, mint, and pasture), Malaysia (Tualang), New Zealand (Manuka), and Spain (chestnut).

pmc-13591124.title: The STEMI Mimic: Cocaine‐Associated Pulmonary Embolism With ST‐Segment Elevation
pmc-13591124.creator: Kishan Reddy, Dhairya Nanavaty, Sohrab Singh, Parasuram Krishnamoorthy, Pedro Moreno, Satabdi Datta Choudhury
pmc-13591124.description: Cocaine has been linked to both myocardial infarction (MI) and pulmonary embolism (PE), with the latter occasionally mimicking acute coronary syndrome. We report a 54‐year‐old man with polysubstance abuse who was found unresponsive and revived with naloxone. He developed chest pain with electrocardiogram showing ST‐segment elevation in V2–V3 and elevated troponin, suggestive of anteroseptal ST‐elevation MI (STEMI).

pmc-13652861.title: Parietal signatures of urge control in paediatric tic disorders: Hyperactivation and salience-biased coupling
pmc-13652861.creator: Theresa V Heinen, Julia Schmidgen, Stephan Bender, Kerstin Konrad
pmc-13652861.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Premonitory urges (PU) are central to tic expression and guide behavioural treatment yet are difficult to measure in children using self-report because urge awareness often lags tic onset. We therefore examined neural correlates of urge control in paediatric tic disorders (TS) across natural urge conditions (blink, yawn) and tics, using an fMRI release-suppression task in 25 medication-naïve children and adolescents with TS (76% male; 7–16 years) and 25 matched typically developing control participants (76% male; 6–17 years).

uslaw-usc-t38-s2306.description: United States Code, Title 38 (Veterans’ Benefits); Part II (General Benefits); Chapter 23 (Burial Benefits). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary shall furnish, when requested, appropriate Government headstones or markers at the expense of the United States for the unmarked graves of the following: (1) Any individual buried in a national cemetery or in a post cemetery.
